_status: The learner guide's Try it 2.1 situations and model answers (Module 2 learner guide, pages 5 and 18). A different answer with a sound reason can also be right.

items.text: The portal's admin page can be reached from the internet, and it still uses the vendor's default password.

facts.v: Admin page open to the internet with a default password
Close the admin page to the internet; change the password; add MFA

items.text: The whole approval team uses one login for the approval spreadsheet.

facts.v: One account per person, with logs

items.text: A contractor who left two months ago can still connect through the VPN.

facts.v: Access not removed when a contractor left
Disable accounts on the last day; review accounts monthly

items.text: Backups run every night, but no one has ever tried to restore one.

facts.v: Test a restore regularly; keep an offline copy

items.text: Field staff carry applicant forms on their personal USB sticks.

facts.v: Applicant forms on personal USB sticks
Office-issued encrypted USB sticks, with the head's approval and at most 1,000 records at a time (DPA Sec. 23)

items.text: The server's operating system reached end of support last year and no longer gets security updates.

facts.v: The server and everything on it
Plan the upgrade; meanwhile isolate it and record the risk
